notes.title: New Jessika Update available!
notes.notes:
Hi everybody!

Please be aware that we have prepared a small update, including some bugfixes and adjustments based on the feedback we have received since release.
Find all details below:

[h3]Fixes[/h3]
[list][*][b]Terminal:[/b] The terminal got stuck and cannot receive any more input.
[*][b]Chat:[/b] Reply window got stuck and covers the chat. 
[*][b]Decrypter:[/b] UI elements where displayed outside its window.
[*][b]E-Mails:[/b] Wrong date and time were displayed. 
[*][b]Help:[/b] Text was cut off and file icons were not positioned correctly next to its texts.[/list]

[h3]Adjustments/Additions[/h3]
[list][*][b]Glitch:[/b] Glitch volume on video was too loud.
[*][b]Glitch:[/b] Overall weh ave reduced the amount of glitches.
[*][b]Tags:[/b] Some tags were not showing results in a different language e.g. when entering "Blut" -> "Blood".
[*][b]Conversations:[/b] Certain conversations are dependent on each other and only triggered, after the dependency has been triggered, and not showing up before.
[*][b]Subtitles:[/b] Subtitles now stay open once you open them. 
[*][b]Slight amendments to the game's ending:[/b] [i]Without any spoilers:[/i] Based on player feedback, we have made small amendments to the ending of Jessika.
[*][b]Added some new Tags:[/b] Additionally, we added some more tags, based on player feedback.[/list]

notes.title: Jessika Release Livestream - Today, at 6pm CEST
notes.notes:
In celebration of the release of Jessika, we will be livestreaming Jessika today, starting at 6pm CEST on the official Assemble Entertainment Twitch channel, Youtube and Steam.

Jessika's release-livestream will be hosted by Assemble-Newcomer Maria. 

Stream starts today, at 6pm CEST, on following official channels of your choosing:
